c.h: Shorthand for the 𦥑 and 爻 components in the traditional character 學.

c.h: Here used to represent a target.

矦.o: Pictograph of an arrow (矢) hitting a target (厂). Variant of 侯.

蒦.o: Depicts a hand (又) catching an owl (雈).

c.h: 虍 is a component form of 虎.

豦.o: Phonosemantic compound. 豕 represents the meaning and 虍 represents the sound.

閦.o: A crowd 众 walking through a gate 門
